'''Sean Munro''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|FRS}}<ref name=frs>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/sean-munro-11987/|title=Sean Munro |publisher=[[Royal Society]]|location=London|author=Anon|year=2011|website=royalsociety.org}}</ref> is a Group Leader at the [[Medical Research Council (United Kingdom)|Medical Research Council]] (MRC) [[Laboratory of Molecular Biology]] (LMB).<ref name=whoswho>{{Who's Who | title=Munro, Dr (Bruce) Sean| |author=Anon|id =U256393| year = 2016 | doi=10.1093/ww/9780199540884.013.U256393| edition = online [[Oxford University Press]]|location=Oxford}}</ref><ref name=golgi>{{cite journal|last1=Short|first1=Ben|title=Sean Munro: Revealing the Golgi's true identity|journal=The Journal of Cell Biology|volume=192|issue=1|year=2011|pages=4–5|issn=0021-9525|doi=10.1083/jcb.1921pi|pmc=3019565|pmid=21220504}}</ref><ref name=gs>{{Google scholar id}}</ref><ref name=scopus>{{Scopus id}}</ref> From 2012 until 2023, he served as head of the Cell Biology Division.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Biology |first=©2023 MRC Laboratory of Molecular |last2=Avenue |first2=Francis Crick |last3=Campus |first3=Cambridge Biomedical |last4=CB2 0QH |first4=Cambridge |last5=Uk. 01223 267000 |title=Scientific Leadership: Directors, Deputy Directors & Heads of Divisions |url=https://www2.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/about-lmb/scientific-leadership-directors-deputy-directors-heads-of-divisions/ |access-date=2023-03-27 |website=MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology |language=en-GB}}</ref>
